# Agent Skills



This repository contains [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io/home) for Google
products and technologies, including [Google Cloud](https://cloud.google.com).

> [!NOTE]
> This repository is under active development.

## Installation

```bash
npx skills add google/skills
```

From the `npx install` command, you can select the specific skills from this
repo to install.

## Plugins

This repo also bundles Google product plugins (Skills + MCP servers) for agent harnesses.

| Agent harness | Install |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Claude Code** | `claude plugin marketplace add google/skills`, then `claude plugin install <plugin>@google-plugins` |
| **Codex** | `codex plugin marketplace add google/skills`, then install from the `/plugins` browser |
| **Antigravity CLI** | `agy plugin install https://github.com/google/skills/<plugin-path>` |

## Support

If you need help or encounter issues with these skills, search for existing

[GitHub Issue Tracker](https://github.com/google/skills/issues).

## Contributing

We welcome contributions to improve our skills. You can help by:

*   [Reporting bugs or inaccuracies](https://github.com/google/skills/issues) in
    the skill Markdown files.
*   Suggesting new skills to add to this repository (for example, Google
    technologies or recipes) by filing a feature request.

## License

You are free to copy, modify, and distribute these skills under the terms of the
Apache 2.0 license. See the `LICENSE` file for details.

aiSummary.oneLiner: A collection of reusable, composable skills for building advanced conversational AI agents.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository provides a standardized library of modular 'skills' designed to be integrated into conversational AI systems and autonomous agents. Developed by Google, it aims to create a common interface for common tasks, such as web searching, calendar management, and basic calculations, allowing developers to plug and play capabilities. The framework emphasizes composability, enabling complex behaviors to be constructed by chaining multiple fundamental skills together. It is built to be agnostic of the underlying LLM, focusing on the execution and parameterization of the tasks.
keyFeatures: Standardized interfaces: Defines a consistent contract for inputs and outputs across all provided skills.
Modular design: Allows developers to import only the specific capabilities they need without pulling in a monolithic framework.
LLM agnostic: Designed to work with various large language models by focusing on tool execution rather than prompt generation.
Skill composition: Enables the chaining of multiple basic skills to perform complex, multi-step operations.
Pre-built capabilities: Includes a library of common tasks like web search, data retrieval, and basic scheduling.

useCases.title: Virtual assistant development
useCases.description: Developers build custom conversational agents that can check weather, manage schedules, and search the web using these modular components.

useCases.title: Enterprise automation
useCases.description: Teams integrate specific skills into their internal chat bots to allow employees to query databases or trigger workflows.

useCases.title: Cross-platform agents
useCases.description: Engineers use the standardized interfaces to ensure their agent's tools work consistently regardless of which LLM is powering the reasoning.

useCases.title: Rapid prototyping
useCases.description: Hackathon participants quickly assemble complex agent behaviors by chaining together pre-built skills from the library.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: AI developers and software engineers building conversational interfaces or autonomous agents. Requires familiarity with Python and basic agent architecture concepts.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: Install the package and review the examples directory for how to initialize and combine skills.
